notes.title: Game Development News
notes.content:
so, i got almost infinite exams to do this month and next month, so i still got no time to develop alpr / tsp again
and my discord got banned for "Stealing Personal Data" Like, bro??

this is it, the game is goin to be stuck at time for some months :(

update (final update of this year probably) 2024.14.09

- added 78 graphical options
texture resolution, shadow res, resolution, graphics mode, performance mod using dx11-dx10 (restart the game to deactivate it) and much more
- added portuguese goofy ahh voice (its my voice in every ccharacter, my friends called me femboy bc of my damn voice 😭😭😭)
- added russian goofy ahh voice (used ai to voice every character, goofy too)
- added 3 sectors to chapter 2

- i gave up on sm things of my life bc everything is failing, fail idk how to say it

this is all
